transparent_recipe: Robust composite of seven timing, rate, pitch, and intensity deviations, referenced to the same executive and leaving the focal call out where possible.
organization_research_use: Within-person behavioral change, adaptation, impression management, and responses to changing organizational conditions.
required_validation: Speaker identity, segmentation, alternative feature specifications, and recording-condition sensitivity.
not_an_inference_of: Emotion, confidence, intent, deception, or executive quality.

transparent_recipe: Composite restricted to response latency, speaking-rate change, and long word-onset gaps relative to the executive's anchor.
organization_research_use: Interactional pressure, conversational adaptation, turn-taking, and reactions to challenging or unexpected questions.
what_a_transcript_misses: When an answer begins, how quickly it unfolds, and how speech is temporally disrupted.
required_validation: Turn boundaries, word timestamps, overlap-sensitive diarization, and question-type comparisons.

transparent_recipe: Personal-baseline delivery deviation minus transcript-visible deviation for the same answer.
organization_research_use: When embodied delivery changes even though wording appears routine; multimodal inconsistency and information omitted by text-only analysis.
what_a_transcript_misses: The difference between what was said and how the answer was delivered.
required_validation: Alternative transcript benchmarks, robustness across microphones, and blinded review of selected examples.
not_an_inference_of: A contradiction, lie, concealed emotion, or strategic intent.

transparent_recipe: Interquartile range of answer-level personal-baseline deviation within the same Q&A session.
organization_research_use: Behavioral consistency, adaptation across topics or analysts, and sequencing within high-stakes interactions.
what_a_transcript_misses: How much delivery varies across otherwise similar answers in one event.
required_validation: Minimum answer count, topic and analyst controls, sensitivity to aggregation, and sequence-aware models.
not_an_inference_of: A stable personality trait or lack of self-control.

transparent_recipe: Median pitch-variability difference between Q&A answers and prepared remarks in the same call.
organization_research_use: Differences between planned communication and unscripted interaction, including emotional labor and communication adaptation.
what_a_transcript_misses: Within-speaker vocal change across interactional conditions.
required_validation: Prepared/Q&A section labels, usable pitch tracking, and same-call recording continuity.
not_an_inference_of: More or less emotion; the shift is an acoustic contrast only.
